title: Hub and file discussions
description: Open a forum-style discussion on a hub or a file, comment, reply, and watch the thread. This is separate from a club feed.
content:
A discussion sits on a hub or on a file inside it. Think of it as a forum next to the work. People who can open the work can read the thread, comment, reply, and watch it. This is not the club feed.

Primary action: Open a hub you can access, then open its discussion.

Open a discussion

  • Hub: open the hub, then open the discussion for the hub as a whole.
  • File: open a file inside the hub, then open the discussion for that file.

If you cannot open the hub, you cannot join its discussion.

Comment and reply

  • Write a comment on the hub or the file.
  • Reply under a comment that is already there.

Watch a thread

Watch a discussion when you want to know it moved. Turn the watch off when you are done.

Not the club feed

Club posts, comments, and reactions live on the club. Hub and file discussions live on the work. If you want a group with a list, a focus, and events, use a club instead.
